name: showreel-pv-c3-greytext2

voice.text: This menu is hard to read. The soft grey looked nice, but it's too light. Turns out, text needs contrast. First, darken the words. Next, lighten the board a touch. Then check the ratio, and aim for four and a half to one. Same menu, now easy to read.

before.mistake: light grey text on a cream board (about 2.4 to 1): the soft, elegant look that fails the 4.5 to 1 minimum for body text

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (a café specials board on a counter) fills the frame by design

note: Preview study (24 Nov 2026), not a post: the held grey-text reel rebuilt on the improved design kit (rules-c3.md V1-V3, B1-B3, P1-P2). Rendered with Showreel 'seconds' into R2 study/. No captions.json entry.
